verdicts.reason: A keeps the original centered layout: the two-tone serif headline, the orange brand line and the bottom legal line all sit on one axis with balanced space. Its only flaw is that the legal line is still very small. B pushes the headline and brand line into the top third and leaves a large dead area below. It enlarges the brand line until it competes with the headline, and it rewraps the headline so 'Sip at' breaks the original white/gold rhythm. Its legal text sits left-aligned at an arbitrary height, off the centered axis, so it looks like an accident.
